highlights: Custom CMS: edits commit JSON to GitHub, and a GitHub Action rebuilds and publishes the static pages
Editable fields are defined by data-cms annotations in one HTML template, with the admin schema generated from it
Sign-in with Google, emailed links or password; team roles and an activity log
Anonymous analytics: pages, sources, countries, devices, WhatsApp taps, plans chosen and forms sent
Light and dark themes, responsive layout and rich link previews
name: OneGrid Energies Website & CMS
summary: Website for a Nigerian clean-energy company, edited by staff in a custom CMS that republishes it on every save.
description: The public site at onegridenergies.com is plain static HTML, one folder per page, so it can be hosted anywhere with no server. Staff edit it in a separate admin app on Render: page text, photos, videos, lists (gallery, partners, impact figures, solar plans, FAQ, reviews), contact details and SEO, with uploads going straight to Cloudinary. Each save commits the content as JSON to GitHub, and a GitHub Action rebuilds the pages from a single annotated template. The admin also has team accounts (Google, emailed link or password sign-in), an activity log and privacy-friendly visitor analytics.
